steps.instruction: Do not change anything; leave Button 4 assigned to Mouse Function > Back.
During capture set Button 4 to Multimedia > Play/Pause exactly once.
During capture set Button 4 to Multimedia > Stop exactly once.
During capture set Button 4 to Multimedia > Next exactly once.
During capture set Button 4 to Multimedia > Previous exactly once.
During capture set Button 4 to Multimedia > Mute Volume exactly once.
During capture set Button 4 to Multimedia > Volume Up exactly once.
During capture set Button 4 to Multimedia > Volume Down exactly once.
During capture set Button 4 back to Multimedia > Play/Pause exactly once.
During capture set Button 4 back to Multimedia > Stop exactly once.
During capture set Button 4 back to Multimedia > Next exactly once.
During capture set Button 4 back to Multimedia > Previous exactly once.
During capture set Button 4 back to Multimedia > Mute Volume exactly once.
During capture restore Button 4 to Mouse Function > Back exactly once.
